vulnerabilities.description: The method `testDomain()` contains a dangerous call `Process process = Runtime.getRuntime().exec("sh", "-c", "ping -c 1"+domainName));` at line 25 that processes data without adequate security controls.
vulnerabilities.impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary OS commands on the server, potentially achieving full system compromise including data exfiltration, lateral movement, and persistent backdoor installation.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Avoid shell command execution entirely. Use Java APIs directly (e.g., HttpURLConnection for HTTP requests). If shell invocation is unavoidable, use ProcessBuilder with a fixed command array (no shell expansion) and validate input against a strict allowlist.

vulnerabilities.description: The method `testWebsite()` contains an Insecure Direct Object Reference ('Injection') that processes data without adequate security controls.
vulnerabilities.impact: An attacker can read or modify arbitrary application files on the server by using path traversal sequences (../), directory browsing, or virtual paths to access configuration files (.htaccess,.env), credentials stored as environment variables, etc., potentially accessing database configurations, source codes, API keys, AWS/GCP creds, S3 bucket policies & settings, cloud function URLs, CloudFront distributions configs, IAM roles for services used with EC2 metadata service at http://169.254.169.254/, Kubernetes secrets via env vars injected into pods through ConfigMaps / Secrets, Docker daemon socket mounts (/var/run/docker.sock ->  unix://localhost/var/snap/microk8s/common/dockerd.socket ), Jenkins home dir (-DJENKINS_HOME:/home/jenkins/.jenkins/) , Maven local repo location(-DLINUXDEPLOYER_MAVENREPOLOCATION : ~/.m2 )
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Review all user input before incorporating it into any filepath structure ("filename/".concat("/").concat(userInput)). Use PathTravel checks against allowed base directories.
